# Open Location Code

Unmodified browser/CommonJS implementation from Google's Open Location Code project.

- Upstream: https://github.com/google/open-location-code
- Revision: `83986da0156bbf51fba33d0327d8ca4b7f955c89`
- Source: `js/src/openlocationcode.js`
- Retrieved: 2026-09-13
- License: Apache-2.0; the upstream license is included in `LICENSE`.

The `OpenLocationCode` browser global encodes and decodes Plus Codes locally. No API key, network request, or Google Maps SDK is required. Keep the copyright notice and license when updating this copy.
